title: Shared accounts and missing MFA
condition: A shared password with no MFA let the attacker in; leaver accounts and generic supplier admin accounts had the same weakness.
recommendation: Finish named accounts with MFA for every user of member data; check monthly.

title: Supplier oversight stops at the contract
condition: Agreements exist, but critical suppliers do not alert the Club or answer out of hours; two processors have no agreement.
recommendation: Add alerting, out-of-hours contact and incident support terms to all critical supplier contracts; sign the two missing agreements.

title: No authority to warn members quickly
condition: The delegation of authority did not cover member warnings, so a decision waited 2 days while fraud continued.
recommendation: Delegate pre-approved fraud warnings to the DPO, informing the General Manager; adopt the template.

title: One awareness programme for data, security and AI
condition: Three projects found the same gap: staff lack training on phishing, data handling and AI use.
recommendation: Run one combined training programme by April 2027 and repeat the phishing simulation.

title: Recovery depends on supplier backups
condition: Nightly supplier backups and no spare CCTV recorder leave recovery targets unmet.
recommendation: Decide on backup frequency and fund a spare recorder; record any risk acceptance.
